summary: All six focused mutations caused the expected bounded failure and every restored implementation passed its declared positive control.

controls.mutation: Run the inherited test contract against the already-English metric emitter before repairing its stale Romanian expectations.
controls.expected_failure: The focused metric suite rejects the stale copy contract.
controls.observed_failure: Three assertions failed: the account headline, unavailable classification, and unavailable account fallback still expected Romanian copy; 9 tests passed.
controls.restored_positive: The repaired focused metric suite passed 12/12.

controls.mutation: Force the dashboard money formatter to render RON instead of the report currency.
controls.expected_failure: The dashboard currency assertion and report snapshots reject the wrong unit.
controls.observed_failure: The bounded UI suite failed 6 tests, including the direct EUR row assertion and report snapshots showing RON instead of EUR; 91 tests passed.
controls.restored_positive: After restoring report.currencyCode, the bounded UI suite passed 97/97.

controls.mutation: Force the catalog money formatter to render RON instead of its currencyCode prop.
controls.expected_failure: The catalog's direct currency assertion and report snapshots reject the wrong unit.
controls.observed_failure: The bounded UI suite failed 5 tests, including the direct catalog assertion and report snapshots showing RON instead of EUR; 92 tests passed.
controls.restored_positive: After restoring currencyCode, the bounded UI suite passed 97/97.

controls.mutation: Force the profitability simulator money formatter to render RON instead of its currencyCode prop.
controls.expected_failure: The simulator's direct money assertions reject the wrong unit.
controls.observed_failure: The bounded UI suite failed 4 simulator tests on visible EUR amounts while 93 tests passed.
controls.restored_positive: After restoring currencyCode, the bounded UI suite passed 97/97.

controls.mutation: Build the immediate V2 view from the stale session currency instead of the opened signed snapshot currency.
controls.expected_failure: The signed snapshot transport test rejects stale session currency.
controls.observed_failure: Exactly 1 test failed because the report rendered EUR instead of the GBP value carried by the opened signed snapshot; 96 tests passed.
controls.restored_positive: After restoring openedReportSnapshot.reportV2.currencyCode, the bounded UI suite passed 97/97.

controls.mutation: Replace the English report metadata title with a Romanian title.
controls.expected_failure: The independent public metadata snapshot rejects the visible language regression.
controls.observed_failure: Exactly 1 public boundary test failed on metadata:report while 96 tests passed.
controls.restored_positive: After restoring the English title, the bounded UI suite passed 97/97.
